name: Serpent Wild
summary: At Freewind Post, Hagar Lightninghoof sends you northwest after signs of Arikara emerge in Thousand Needles. Strange eggs point to a vengeance spirit from tauren legend, and Hagar seeks Motega Firemane's counsel at Whitereach Post.

sections.title: A Legend Made Flesh
sections.body: Strange eggs have appeared across Thousand Needles, and local tauren fear an ecological disaster. Their signs point beyond ordinary predators to Arikara, a vengeance spirit from old tauren tales. The evidence shakes Hagar Lightninghoof. A threat he knew only from fireside lore now faces the canyon.

sections.title: The Road to Whitereach
sections.body: Hagar Lightninghoof seeks Motega Firemane's counsel because this danger reaches beyond physical defense. Motega watches over the canyon floor from Whitereach Post, northwest of Freewind Post. As a spiritual guide versed in the Needles' traditional omens, he may help the Horde understand the rising spirit and decide whether to appease or destroy it.

faq.q: Who starts the quest Serpent Wild?
faq.answer: Hagar Lightninghoof at Freewind Post starts it, right after you deliver the strange egg found in the canyon.
Motega Firemane is at Whitereach Post, a small tauren camp along the road northwest of Freewind Post, past the fork toward the Great Lift.
Arikara is a legendary wind serpent spirit of vengeance in tauren mythology. Its rumored presence in Thousand Needles threatens the local tribes both spiritually and physically.

faq.q: What prerequisite must be finished before taking this quest?
faq.answer: You must finish Alien Egg first. You recover an unusual egg from the canyon's wild beasts and deliver it to Hagar Lightninghoof for inspection.

faq.q: What happens after reaching Motega Firemane?
faq.answer: Speaking with Motega opens Sacred Fire, which begins the ritual preparations to confront Arikara.

faq.q: Why is Hagar Lightninghoof so alarmed?
faq.answer: Hagar believed the tales of Arikara were only stories. Evidence that the vengeance spirit has appeared in the canyon frightens him, so he seeks elder wisdom at once.

angles.text: As a tauren, you face an urgent crisis as Arikara's awakening tests your people's spiritual stewardship of Thousand Needles.
As a shaman, you see how Arikara's vengeful spirit unsettles the balance of elemental and spiritual forces on the canyon mesas.
As a member of the Horde, you help keep the Thousand Needles supply route open against mystical threats to the road between the Great Lift and Feralas.
